component.name: Ribalta
component.summary: Tiny flip clock and study timer

description.p: Ribalta shows the time on animated flip tiles and doubles as a study companion. It is written in C with SDL3 and stays very light: about 18 MB of RAM and almost no CPU when idle.

ul.li: Flip clock with optional seconds and 12/24-hour format
Study timer, also typed with the number keys
Custom digit colour and any installed font for the digits
Fullscreen and screensaver mode, desktop notifications and a chime

description.p: Fixes the native installer stopping at 0% when run from a terminal, which also broke ribalta update.
In-app legend (H or F1) with every key and where settings and statistics are stored, and a one-line explanation of the selected entry in the settings panel.
Pomodoro break colour of your choice, subject change during a session, daily and weekly study goals with notifications, and (native build) the ribalta --version, update and uninstall commands.
Experimental macOS build. The Flatpak now bundles SDL 3.4, fixing a crash when the window is resized or maximised.
First packaged release: flip clock, study timer, Pomodoro, statistics, digit colour and font picker.
